data.sdk_provenance:
Streamline SDK headers
=====================

Upstream: https://github.com/NVIDIA-RTX/Streamline
Version: v2.14.16
Commit: 625db07d4bca5abc67d781c42af7e7fb0761f1b6

Source archive:
https://github.com/NVIDIA-RTX/Streamline/releases/download/v2.14.16/streamline-sdk-v2.14.16.zip
Size: 276016170 bytes
SHA-256: 32041e51db0cab709a271b72a352281b690c2abbd669a827809401a5dd23956b

The 24 include/*.h files and LICENSE.txt come from the verified official
archive (LICENSE.txt is its license.txt). There are no local SDK patches.
Git normalizes text line endings to LF according to the repository policy.
No NVIDIA runtime DLLs or model binaries are vendored here.

The engine still uses the existing global resource-tagging API. Its deprecated
function type is aliased inside the SDK diagnostic scope in
drivers/streamline/streamline_headers.h; no SDK declaration is modified.
The new Neural Rendering and Dynamic MFG APIs are not enabled by this upgrade.
